draft_fields.short_description: Local speech enhancement for Apple Silicon recordings.
draft_fields.description: Enhance recorded speech locally with bundled AuK models, compare original and processed audio, and export mono 48 kHz, 24-bit WAV. Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 14 or later. The small setup assistant downloads approximately 6.5 GB of app-image files before installation; Internet is needed for setup. Enhancement then works offline and is not real time. Generative processing can alter speech, so compare the complete result with the preserved original. Application source is MIT licensed; bundled dependencies and models retain separate licenses.
draft_fields.version_changes: Fixes the startup handshake; uses MLX wheels compatible with the macOS14 baseline; adds the signed native setup assistant. See public qualification for exact bytes and validation limits.
draft_fields.system_requirements: Apple Silicon Mac, macOS14 or later; 16 GB memory recommended. Setup needs Internet and approximately 6.5 GB of downloads, plus storage for the app image, installed app, recordings and exports. Enhancement runs offline; processing is not real time.

draft_fields.description: Voicy is a focused tool for enhancing recorded speech on Apple Silicon Macs. It runs AuK locally with bundled models, without an account or audio upload. Import a recording, compare original and enhanced versions, then export a mono WAV. It is intended for speech cleanup, not transcription, a full recording studio, live microphone filtering or music mastering. macOS 14 or later is required. Allow storage for the bundled models and time for processing. Generative enhancement can change words or voice texture, so listen to the complete result before publishing.
